name: invite

metadata.description: Account invitation containing the fully resolved frontend acceptance link.
notes: `user` is a dict (user.to_dict('basic')) auto-injected by User.send_template_email if missing.
`token_url` is built server-side from tenant/project WEBAPP_BASE_URL and WEBAPP_AUTH_PATH settings, then may be shortened.

text_template:
Hello{% if user.display_name %} {{ user.display_name }}{% endif %},

You've been invited to join.

Open this secure link to continue:
{{ token_url }}

If you weren't expecting this invitation, you can ignore this email.
html_template:
You're invited

Hello{% if user.display_name %} {{ user.display_name }}{% endif %},

You've been invited to join. Use the secure link below to continue.

Accept invitation

If the button does not work, copy and paste this link into your browser:

{{ token_url }}

If you weren't expecting this invitation, you can ignore this email.

Sent by Django-MOJO
